note: U29 of the 2026-11-03 usage audit: an effect on a surface or device class the plan did not name is at least MATERIAL, since no planned check looked there (one such effect filed MINOR took 14% of its run in rework). The fixture's plan asks for a dollar sign in the create-order API response; the build put it in the money formatter the order-confirmation email shares, so the email now reads 'Total: $12.50 USD', no test covers it and the suite stays green. Graded: the review ran, its six fields printed, and a BLOCKER or MATERIAL punch-list line names the email effect. A run that never names the email fails the severity step too - finding it is the review's pass 4 (the changed symbols' callers), unchanged by the edit, so the evidence file reads that step beside the found-at-all count. Every step is bound to this fixture (session: false). PF1: the three plan-status steps grade the after arm (plan folders, the script installed); the before arm (3.11.0, flat plans, no script) reads them as - ticks-through-plan-status FAILS by construction (no script to call), so its shipping row is better and an INCONCLUSIVE means the after arm did not go through the script; status-json-never-edited and approved-plan-never-edited pass with nothing to edit, and are WORSE only when the after arm edits one.
